indicators.description: Pressure on crude/LNG flows through the Strait of Hormuz, fusing Iran geopolitical risk, sanctions momentum, oil price action, the dated chokepoint status, and live vessel density.

inputs.role: WTI 5-day absolute % move (market pricing of disruption risk)

labels.calm: Hormuz flows look normal — no stacked pressure signals on the strait.
labels.critical: Multiple pressure signals on Hormuz energy flows — desks should check tanker positions and Brent exposure now.
labels.elevated: Several pressure signals stacking on Hormuz — check live tanker positions, Brent/WTI exposure, and war-risk pricing.
labels.watch: Early pressure building around Hormuz — worth a glance at tanker positions and crude exposure.

indicators.methodology_note: score = sum over live inputs of (weight * transformed value), weights renormalized to live inputs. Chokepoint status is a dated 2026-11-02 snapshot (weight 0.10, context only). Vessel density is conditional on >= 1 vessel visible (free AIS tier has sparse Gulf coverage; zero vessels = coverage gap, not safety).
indicators.name: Hormuz Energy Flow Risk

indicators.description: Disruption risk to Russian-origin energy supply (crude, products, gas), fusing Russia risk, sanctions designation momentum, and Brent/gas price action.

labels.calm: Russian supply picture quiet — no stacked signals.
labels.critical: Russian supply risk critical — desks should reassess crude, product, and gas exposure immediately.
labels.elevated: Pressure building on Russian supply lines — review exposure to Urals/Brent spreads and gas.
labels.watch: Early signals around Russian supply — monitor sanctions headlines and Brent.

indicators.methodology_note: score = sum over live inputs of (weight * transformed value), weights renormalized to live inputs.
indicators.name: Russia Supply Risk

indicators.description: Cross-strait escalation pressure, fusing China and Taiwan composite risk scores with China sanctions designation momentum.

labels.calm: Cross-strait picture calm — no stacked escalation signals.
labels.critical: Cross-strait escalation signals critical — desks should check Strait shipping, chip supply chains, and haven positioning.
labels.elevated: Cross-strait tension elevated — review Taiwan Strait shipping exposure and semiconductor supply-chain hedges.
labels.watch: Cross-strait temperature rising — watch PLA activity reporting and Taipei headlines.

indicators.methodology_note: score = sum over live inputs of (weight * transformed value), weights renormalized to live inputs. Taiwan is scored with kind=country (verified resolving 2026-11-02).
indicators.name: China–Strait Tension

indicators.description: Near-term US macro event risk: high-importance calendar events in the next 7 days fused with VIX level and VIX momentum.

inputs.role: count of high-importance events in next 7 days

labels.calm: Macro calendar light and vol subdued — no near-term event risk stacking.
labels.critical: Macro event risk critical — major catalysts imminent with vol spiking. Desks should be hedged into the events.
labels.elevated: Macro event risk elevated — high-importance events within days and/or vol repricing. Check positioning into the prints.
labels.watch: Some macro event risk on the near horizon or vol ticking up — check the calendar.

indicators.methodology_note: score = sum over live inputs of (weight * transformed value), weights renormalized to live inputs. Calendar is the curated registry (static by construction — always live). VIX momentum uses the 5-day absolute % move of ^VIX.
indicators.name: US Macro Event Risk

indicators.description: Unrest pressure around upcoming elections: elections in the calendar within 30 days, each scored by its country's composite risk; top 3 kept.

labels.calm: No elections in the next 30 days carry meaningful unrest pressure.
labels.critical: Election unrest risk critical — a near-term vote coincides with severe unrest signals. Desks should reassess country exposure.
labels.elevated: Upcoming election(s) carry elevated unrest pressure — review exposure to the affected country.
labels.watch: An upcoming election shows some unrest pressure — monitor local reporting.

indicators.methodology_note: Dynamic inputs: for each election event in the next 30 days, fetch /api/risk for the event country (kind=auto). Keep the top 3 by score with weights 0.5/0.3/0.2 renormalized to the countries that resolve. No elections in window -> score 0, calm, high confidence (calendar is static by construction). Unresolvable countries are skipped as degraded inputs.
indicators.name: Election Unrest Risk

meta.note: OSTARA fusion layer: proprietary curated indicators. The IP is in the curation — which inputs are fused, their weights, the per-input normalization transforms, and the label thresholds. Raw feeds are public; the fusion recipe is not. Weights redistribute over live inputs when a feed is degraded; missing inputs lower confidence, never fabricate values.

transforms.chokepoint_status: categorical map of the dated status string: contains block/clos -> 90; disrupt/partial/restrict -> 65; congest -> 40; else 15.
transforms.price_move_pct: abs(% change over last N closes) * k, clamped to 100. k=12: a 5% move -> 60.
transforms.vessel_density: min(vessel_count / 40 * 100, 100). CONDITIONAL: contributes only when count >= 1; a zero count with a healthy vessels feed is treated as a coverage gap (input degraded, weight redistributed), never as zero risk.
